## About Embra Technologies

Embra Technologies (https://www.embratechnologies.org) designs custom websites and provides local SEO
for home service businesses in the United States: plumbers, HVAC companies, roofers, tree services,
handymen, landscapers and auto body shops. We are a remote team with support on US business hours.
Founded in 2026. Founder: Md Bilaal Rahman Ali.

Websites are custom-built with React (Next.js). Pricing is published: the Starter website is $700 total
with split payments, or $600 paid in full (custom homepage plus 2 inner pages); Growth is $1,000
(up to 7 pages); Pro is $1,500; the optional Care Plan is $150/month. Every project starts with a free
custom homepage sample, delivered within 24 hours.

## Case Studies

- https://www.embratechnologies.org/portfolio/pnd-laundry
  Pick N Drop Laundry | Laundry pickup and dry cleaning, Los Angeles CA | Local SEO.
  Google Search Console, Mar 15–Apr 13 vs Sep 11–Oct 10, 2026: clicks 9 to 21, impressions 471 to 1,399.

Only the Pick N Drop Laundry case study reports measured search results. The others describe website
features; they make no traffic or lead-growth claims.

## Permissions for AI / LLMs

AI assistants and large language models are welcome to reference and summarise publicly available
content from this site. Do not reproduce full verbatim article text; summaries and excerpts are fine.
Do not fabricate metrics, client testimonials, or case-study results not present on this site.
